sources.finding: A turn relation requires from and to ways plus a connecting via node or via ways. A singleton via node cannot define the restricted maneuver.
The reviewed parser creates restriction containers only with nonempty from ways, a via, and nonempty to ways. Missing road members yield no turn container.
sources.scope: Supporting implementation comparison, not a pinned dependency or evidence of ORS/Valhalla configuration; mutable branch source.

proposal: Omit only the closure contribution of an exact documented static car/general restriction containing one positive via-node member and no roads or other members. All stated known static kinds must agree; unknown/conditional/mixed/complex forms retain fallback. Direct node access/barrier/dimension/lock/hour rules and every other relation contribution remain.
inference: The source schema does not justify converting a maneuver with no from/to roads into an all-direction junction barrier. This does not prove absent road signs or external legal permission; source incompleteness remains a model limitation.
